comparison.objective: Orient stack-nest totes correctly and stack them without contacting contained parts; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests reading mating geometry, 180° reorientation, large-object alignment, and controlled lowering. Candidate tests small-tool engagement, captive lock manipulation, collar setting, and dynamic feedback iteration.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both grey totes released on ledges, parts unmoved, and no prior nesting below the ledges. Candidate requires two safe impact cycles and rejects bottoming, overload, rebound, damage, and drift.
comparison.reason: Geometry-based tote orientation and stacking do not test adjustable damping or tool-mediated locking.
